svg.title: Baden study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Baden; 2: Ihringen; 3: Oberrotweil; 4: Malterdingen; 5: Durbach; 6: Neuweier; 7: Efringen-Kirchen; 8: Iffezheim; 9: Stuttgart; 10: Mannheim; 11: Heidelberg; 12: Karlsruhe

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
